sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Dunk Ball are simple yet incredibly challenging. Your goal is to move a basket to catch and score points from incoming basketballs. The twist is that the basket can be moved left, right, up, or down, and the timing and positioning of the basket are crucial to scoring points. The game gets progressively harder as the speed and difficulty level increase, making it essential to develop your reflexes and timing skills.

The game also features different types of basketballs, each with its own characteristics and point values. Some basketballs are worth more points than others, and players will need to adapt their strategy to maximize their score. Additionally, the game includes power-ups and obstacles that can either hinder or help your progress. These elements add a layer of complexity to the game, making it more engaging and addictive.

One of the key aspects of Dunk Ball is its scoring system. Points are awarded based on the type of basketball caught and the speed at which it was caught. The faster the basketball, the higher the points awarded. This means that players will need to time their moves perfectly to maximize their score. The scoring system also includes a multiplier system, which rewards players for consecutive catches and high-scoring sequences.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Dunk Ball are engaging, challenging, and rewarding. Players will need to develop their reflexes, timing, and strategic thinking to succeed in the game.
